cpuAdmissionRationale: Admission samples a full 60-second window: refuse average CPU busy >=75%, or average busy >=60% if ANY sample has normalized one-minute load >=0.75. Missing samples refuse. The reported admission load is the window maximum normalized to the final CPU count.

launchContract: Only the listed trusted foreground tool invocations are admitted (plus positional test-file filters for the single-worker vitest invocation). Every descendant must inherit MATRX_RESOURCE_OWNER unchanged. New sessions/detached children are discovered and stopped by token census. Environment scrubbing, remote process brokers, external daemon handoff and arbitrary shell/script launchers are outside this contract and forbidden. Install skips lifecycle scripts; run required preparation separately through its listed command. WXT server occupies the sole permit until stopped, including while idle; stop it before manual browser testing, using a completed unpacked build. This is cooperative process ownership, not an OS security sandbox. Daemonizing commands are prohibited. macOS can hide protected system-binary environments: such binaries must remain in the owned foreground process group; detached protected system binaries are explicitly unsupported. This guard does not claim to contain arbitrary hostile descendants.
